emptyState.title: Publish your first post to start measuring
emptyState.body: Once a post goes out, Markaestro pulls its views, reach, and engagement from the platform within about an hour, and keeps tracking for 90 days. Follower counts are snapshotted daily for every connected channel.

page.warmingUp: Collecting metrics. The first snapshots arrive about an hour after publishing, then refresh on a decaying schedule for 90 days.

trend.note: Grouped by publish date (UTC). Numbers update as the platforms report them.

modeTitles.publish: What the Posts Published Each Day Have Earned so Far
modeTitles.activity: What Happened Each Day, Across All Posts

trend.noteActivity: Grouped by the day the platforms reported the numbers.
trend.activityEmpty: Activity builds from the next metrics pull onward. Publish-date grouping has the history.

provenance.base: Metrics use each platform's API definitions and can lag native insights by up to 48 hours. A "n/a" means the platform doesn't provide that metric (for example, Threads and TikTok don't report reach). Engagement rate is engagements ÷ reach.
provenance.truncated: Post-level views are based on the {count} most recent posts in this window.

toasts.tooManyRefreshes: Too many refreshes. Try again in a minute.
toasts.pullFailed: Couldn't pull live data. Showing the latest stored numbers.
toasts.updatedOf: Refreshed {updated} of {scanned} posts in this window
toasts.updatedPartial: Refreshed {updated} of {scanned} posts before the time budget ran out. Refresh again for the rest.
toasts.partial: {count, plural, one {# refresh failed} other {# refreshes failed}}: {error}
